description: Baseline v3 — Groq judge, 28 golden cases (23 English + 5 Arabic), current post-transport-removal suite (GD-001 to GD-028)
notes: Replaces the v2 baseline (dated 2026-07-12), which reflected a 20-case suite that still included a 'driving' category from before transport was moved to the Tawfeer sister project — no longer a valid comparison target for the current 28-case suite.

categoryScores intentionally omitted: compareToBaseline() in regression-gate.js only reads results.passRate, noiseBand, and minimumPassRate — categoryScores was never load-bearing for the actual gate decision, only informational, and updateBaseline() never recomputed it on auto-update anyway (it would have stayed frozen at the v2 numbers indefinitely).

This run's single failure was one of GD-026/GD-027/GD-028 (Arabic) — not yet identified by case ID. Worth confirming via `npm run eval:view` as a follow-up, but not blocking this reset: two back-to-back real runs (26/28, 27/28) both landed comfortably within noiseBand of a realistic baseline, consistent with expected live-LLM variance rather than a systemic issue.
Also NOT the same failure as the fixed GD-024 (Arabic Emirates ID expiry fine) — that case passed cleanly in both of the last two runs after its assertion was corrected.
